title: In-Sync CRM — the AI-native CRM your sales team will actually use
shortTitle: Your CRM is where leads go to quietly die #Shorts
desc:
Your CRM is where leads go to quietly die. Reps hate updating it, so you fly blind. In-Sync CRM flips that — the AI does the work for them.

Every channel into one pipeline, tagged by source. Contacts that enrich themselves and get scored. AI call coaching that tells reps exactly what to fix. And a command centre that tells you which deals to chase today.

Less busywork. More closing. A CRM your team will adopt.

title: In-Sync ATS — sourcing is the easy part. We run the hiring pipeline
desc:
Candidates sourced — but where does each one stand? Eight hundred candidates across three spreadsheets. In-Sync ATS puts the whole pipeline on one live screen.

Mandates with deadlines you see slipping before the client calls. Candidates that arrive parsed, de-duplicated and AI-scored. Aadhaar and PAN checks in the flow, audit-ready and DPDP-compliant. And AI calls that guard the gap between offer and day one.

A clean, scored database. Verified placements. Faster time-to-fill.

title: EventSync — registration is the easy part. We run the event day
shortTitle: 40% of your registrations never show up #Shorts
desc:
Your event is your big moment — so why run it on a Google Form, a WhatsApp group and a list at the door? Forty percent never show up.

EventSync runs the day: automatic WhatsApp reminders, and when a guest goes quiet the AI calls them. QR check-in with a live count on every screen. And every guest scored as they leave, so your hottest leads are ranked and waiting the next morning.

A packed room, a flawless day, and leads you can act on immediately.

title: Vendor-Sync — know your vendor before you commit | PAN, GST & bank checks
shortTitle: Every new vendor is a stranger you're about to pay #Shorts
desc:
Every new vendor is a stranger you're about to pay. A PAN, a bank line, nobody checked — and fraud shows up after the purchase order is signed.

Vendor-Sync checks PAN, GST and bank against government sources in minutes, flags duplicate identities and tampered documents, then keeps that verified identity attached through onboarding, every invoice, every advance and every settlement. Vendors file their own paperwork; the AI reads it; your team just approves.

Audit-ready, without a single spreadsheet.

title: In-Sync WhatsApp — official Business API campaigns, AI inbox and templates
desc:
Your customers are already on WhatsApp, and they open it — ninety-eight percent, usually within minutes.

In-Sync WhatsApp is the complete toolkit on the official Business API: broadcast campaigns to your whole list in minutes, personalised and scheduled. An AI inbox trained on your own catalogue that replies in seconds, day or night. Pre-approved templates for marketing, order updates and OTPs. And delivery, open and reply tracking on every send.

Messages that get read, and replies that turn into sales.

title: In-Sync Email — land in the inbox every time | campaigns and automation
shortTitle: You send a thousand emails, half land in spam #Shorts
desc:
You send a thousand emails and half of them land in spam. In-Sync Email is built to actually reach the inbox.

Pick a template, choose your audience, send thousands of personalised emails in minutes. Welcome series, follow-ups and drip sequences that fire the moment someone joins your list. A library of polished templates so every send looks professional. Opens, clicks and bounces tracked in real time.

Emails that land, opens that climb, and a list that turns into revenue.

title: In-Sync Expense — claims, advances and GST credit on autopilot
shortTitle: Every advance is cash that left before anyone checked #Shorts
desc:
Every claim is a number someone typed. Every advance is cash that left before anyone checked.

In-Sync Expense reconciles advances automatically against what's approved — what's owed, what's recovered — with no ledger matching by hand. The AI reads the GST number and the tax straight off the receipt, so input tax credit sitting in a drawer today is recovered tomorrow. Filing takes a minute: a photo, not a form. Every action timestamped with a name on it, and month-end is one click.

Control over every rupee claimed, advanced and taxed.

title: In-Sync Field — GPS-verified visits, your whole field team on one live map
shortTitle: Is your field team visiting customers, or parked at a chai stall? #Shorts
desc:
Your field team is out there somewhere. Are they really visiting customers, or parked at a chai stall?

In-Sync Field shows every rep on a live GPS-verified map with today's route as it happens. Recurring beat plans put the right rep in front of the right customers week after week. Directed visit lists land straight on their phone. And visits, orders, distance and collections come back per rep in one clear report.

Visits you can trust, and a field team you can finally see.

title: Work-Sync — you assign, it chases, done means done
shortTitle: You gave the task. Is it done? #Shorts
desc:
You gave the task. Do you know it's done? A message in a group chat is not a system — and the compliance filing nobody closed costs ₹200 a day until someone notices.

Work-Sync puts every task on one screen with an owner, a due date and a priority, and chases them for you. Every stage change reaches the right person — WhatsApp first, email as backup, up the hierarchy. And done means done: the person who assigned the task is the one who signs it off.

Deadlines that hold, a team nobody has to chase, and penalties you never pay.
